title: Integer combinations of integer multiplicity currents (Simon 3.2(1))
statement: Integer combinations of integer multiplicity currents (Simon 3.2(1)). For N, k ∈ ℕ, integer multiplicity X, Y ∈ D_k(ℝ^N), integers a, b and Z ∈ D_k(ℝ^N) with Z(ω) = a·X(ω) + b·Y(ω) for every test form ω, Z is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (X Y Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k) (a b : ℤ), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y → (∀ ω, Z ω = a * X ω + b * Y ω) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Z
